run_DepthFineTuner_fine_tune: run the DepthFineTuner fine_tune method to train a monocular depth model on video frames with joint loss
run_DepthFineTuner_save_depth: run the DepthFineTuner save_depth method to export predicted depth maps as raw float32 images for specified frames
create_DepthFineTuningParams_add_argumen: create an argparse parser with DepthFineTuningParams add_arguments to configure optimizer, learning rate, batch size, and epoch settings
run_log_loss_stats: run the log_loss_stats function to log individual loss statistics including max, min, and mean values to a TensorBoard SummaryWriter
run_write_summary: run the write_summary function to log input images, predicted depth, and geometry consistency masks to TensorBoard
